agenthon.net.note: terms unread: the site's Terms page, read 6.10 (tick 56) on its frozen copy (research/rendered/terms-agenthon-2026-10-06.txt), is the Agenthon 2026 "Terms of Participation" (version 2026-08-17, AH26-POL-02, :24-26), a participant agreement in a four-document policy set (:28-31, the Official Competition Rules, Terms of Participation, Privacy Notice and Data & Software Licensing Policy), not website-use terms: it governs "the legal relationship between participants and the Organizers" (:33), it binds whoever registers, accesses the competition environment or submits (:44-46), and its entire-agreement clause is "concerning the Competition" (:281-282). Read in full, it has no clause on automated access, robots, crawling, scraping, copying or storing the site's pages, or their commercial use; it touches site content only through an ownership reservation under which "no license is granted by implication" (:206-209) and the footer's "All rights reserved" (:305), which neither bar copying nor license it. Its scope over the home and /rules/ pages is unclear, leaning no: "competition environment" (:45) is undefined and the site has Sign In and Sign Up (:15-16), though the Terms name the Competition Site apart from the evaluation environment (:237) (the verifier's reading; the reader's was a flat no). Public pages may carry finalists' names and affiliations (:141-145), and render-watch masks only email addresses. Open: whether SQA's or Stony Brook University's own site terms reach agenthon.net (:52-53, :149), as asked of virtualembryo.ai on 6.10.
